item.title: Baseball scoreboard: Lanier Christian tops Meadowcreek
item.description: Gainesville falls to Roswell in region opener

item.title: Your weekly guide of things to do in and around Hall County
item.description: From arts auctions and horse competitions to bake sales and car shows, there's plenty of unique events in and around Hall County to add to your calendar this week. Here are our top five picks.

item.title: Parents arrested after 8-year-old brought loaded handgun to Myers Elementary
item.description: The parents of an 8-year-old boy who brought a loaded handgun to Myers Elementary School on Thursday have been arrested, according to the Hall County Sheriff’s Office.

item.title: Gainesville man, 20, charged with sharing videos of children being sexually assaulted
item.description: A Gainesville man faces numerous charges after authorities say he shared multiple videos on social media of children being sexually assaulted.

item.title: Rep. Matt Dubnik announces reelection bid for District 29 seat
item.description: State Rep. Matt Dubnik, a Hall County Republican, has announced he will seek re-election to Georgia House District 29 and has qualified to run for another term.

item.title: Gainesville man organizes protest to shed light on Epstein Files. Here are the details
item.description: A march has been organized on the Gainesville square to raise awareness about convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein and to show solidarity with survivors who organizers say were trafficked, raped and tortured.

item.title: This restaurant has closed its Gainesville location. Here’s what we know
item.description: Haydee’s Cafe and Cantina has closed its Gainesville location.

item.title: Hall County sheriff’s attorney issues statement on DUI arrest
item.description: Hall County Sheriff Gerald Couch’s attorney issued a statement Monday urging the public to let the legal process play out following the sheriff’s arrest for DUI, open container and failure to maintain lane.

item.title: High school basketball playoffs: Five storylines for the three quarterfinal programs in Hall County
item.description: Cherokee Bluff girls need three wins to repeat as state champions, No. 1 Gainesville and East Hall are both still in the hunt on the boys side.

item.title: Authorities: Teen poured tuna, cut-up fish in SUV before setting fire to Hoschton home
item.description: A man accused of pouring tuna and cut-up pieces of fish inside a Hoschton resident’s SUV is now charged with setting fire to the person’s home two days later, authorities said.
